sentences.text: Ayllusuchus was an extinct genus of medium-sized sebecid mesoeucrocodylian.
Fossils of this creature have been found in the Lumbrera Formation of Argentina.
The genus Ayllusuchus was described by Gasparini in 1984, with the type species being A. fernandezi.
It belongs to the extinct family Sebecidae, the unranked group Mesoeucrocodylia, and the superorder Crocodylomorpha.
Ayllusuchus lived during the Eocene age, specifically the Casamayoran stage, between 56 and 48.07 million years ago during the Ypresian stage.
